message: The other day, I was showing my kids how to test the smoke alarms, and let me tell you, their reactions were priceless. They thought it was a game, running around pretending to be firefighters while I was just trying to keep a straight face. It dawned on me that turning safety drills into a fun activity not only keeps them engaged but also reinforces the importance of having a plan. Have you ever tried turning a safety lesson into a game? I'd love to hear your stories!
